title: mutation/<model>.json
description: What the mutation check of Stage D measured on one model: every mutant of its sql, and whether its unit tests killed it (README section 3, Stage D).

model.description: must be the dbt model the mutants were made from

id.description: must be the mutant's id, operator/ordinal

operator.description: must name the operator that made the mutant

original.description: must be the text the operator replaced

replacement.description: must be the text it wrote instead

line.description: must be the line of the sql the change is on

occurrence.description: must say which occurrence of the original text in the model this is, so an equivalence entry survives a line moving

verdict.description: must be killed when a unit test failed on the mutant, survived when every unit test passed, or equivalent when a human listed it

reason.description: must be the reason a human gave, for an equivalent mutant

mutants.description: must hold one entry per mutant, in the order they were made

killed.description: must be how many mutants a unit test failed on

survived.description: must be how many mutants every unit test passed on, and nobody listed

equivalent.description: must be how many survivors a human listed as equivalent
